'''Dunya Ertan hidden base''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Dunya Ertan]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-20554">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/20554 hidden base], DeckTech (Dunya "Hardpack" Ertan, 10 January 2002). == Original post ==

'''hidden base'''
* '''Author:''' Dunya "Hardpack" Ertan
* '''Published:''' January 10, 2002
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' its a fun deck

=== Strategy ===

get your planets out and drain and cancel. wait for a beat down.

liberty and home is huge. Use them at the kessel and corusant and laugh. power pivot is great with x-wing canons
